css: <base target="_blank"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><style>*{box-sizing:border-box;}body{font-family:"Hiragino Sans","Yu Gothic",sans-serif;background:#f3f1e9;color:#16241c;margin:0;padding:16px 12px 60px;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;}.wrap{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;}h1{font-size:17px;color:#0f5132;margin:0 0 10px;word-break:break-word;}.card{background:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08);overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}table{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px;min-width:100%;}th,td{padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;}th{background:#f1f0e8;color:#5b6f63;font-size:11px;position:sticky;top:0;}td.name{text-align:left;font-weight:600;}.w{color:#1f6b3a;font-weight:600;}.l{color:#a3372c;font-weight:600;}.d{color:#8a7420;font-weight:600;}a.back{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:10px;color:#0f5132;font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;}pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:11.5px;color:#5b6f63;background:#fbfaf6;padding:10px;border-radius:4px;}input[type=search],input[type=text]{width:100%;font-size:16px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #d8d4c6;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:10px;}a.pl{color:#0f5132;text-decoration:none;}a.op{color:#16241c;text-decoration:none;}.sub{color:#8a8a8a;font-size:11px;}h2.sec{font-size:15px;color:#0f5132;margin:22px 0 8px;}@media (max-width:600px){th,td{padding:5px 6px;font-size:12px;}h1{font-size:15px;}}</style>
